newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VICENZA WIN THEIR FIRST TROPHY IN 95 YEARS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VICENZA WIN THEIR FIRST TROPHY IN 95 YEARS.

text.p: Vicenza beat a 10-man Napoli 3-0 after extra time on Thursday to win the Italian Cup final 3-1 on aggregate for the first trophy of their 95-year history and a place in Europe next season.

Gianpiero Maini in the 20th minute and then substitute Maurizio Rossi and Alessandro Iannuzzi provided the goals, the last two coming in the 117th and 120th minutes to guarantee their first appearance in the Cup winners' Cup.
The match was marred by repeated throwing of flares at Vicenza supporters by Napoli fans.
Helmeted riot police baton charged the Napoli end as fighting broke out after the final whistle at Vicenza's antiquated Romeo Menti stadium.
Napoli, who had won the first leg 1-0 in Naples, found themselves a goal down when Maini slotted home a rebound after Napoli goalkeeper Giuseppe Taglialatela parried his earlier header with his legs.

The score stayed at 1-0 for the rest of the 90 minutes in a scrappy and unimpressive battle between two teams without big name stars seeking to rescue a season that promised much but delivered little.
Napoli striker Nicola Caccia was sent off in the second minute of extra time after apparently elbowing midfielder Fabio Viviani in the face while breaking down the wing.
Napoli coach Vincenzo Montefusco was sent off the bench in the second period as tempers flared.
